question:

history.name: WebSurfer
history.content: Context note: In typical fast-food reporting, desserts are considered food items; beverages (soda, coffee, shakes) are drinks. Since the prompt says "food (not including drinks)", it's reasonable to include desserts as food and exclude any items categorized as Drink.

mistake_reason: At step 9, the orchestrator explicitly instructed the team to include all categories (Food, Drink, Dessert) in the final total, despite the user’s clear requirement to exclude drinks. This directive overrides the task's negative constraint and leads to reporting the grand total (119,960.00) instead of the required food-only amount (89,706.00). This is a direct violation of the task specification (Disobey Task Specification, FM-1.1).
